name: Spell Effect: Shadow Form

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Granted by Shadow Form

You gain immunity to precision damage, resistance to void and to non-magical physical damage, and weakness to any damage with the light trait. You can Squeeze at full speed through any space with at least one dimension a foot wide. Your shadow spells deal additional damage equal to the spell's rank (of the same damage type as the spell).
